annotations.annotation_text: Viconian marker "thunder" on page 57 ("The Trial of HCE"): Giambattista Vico's cyclical philosophy — divine, heroic, and human ages followed by thundering ricorso — structures this passage within the public trial and persecution of HCE, the ballad of Hosty, and the testimony of witnesses. The current Age of Gods phase shapes the language, institutional imagery, and historical echoes of the dream.
sources: Beckett, Samuel. Dante... Bruno. Vico.. Joyce. https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
Ricorso.net: Viconian Structure in FW. https://www.ricorso.net

annotations.annotation_text: Tavern/jury motif "bar" on page 57 ("The Trial of HCE"): the twelve customers drinking in HCE's Chapelizod pub represent public opinion, the Zodiac, and the Apostles within the public trial and persecution of HCE, the ballad of Hosty, and the testimony of witnesses. During this Age of Gods phase, they judge, condemn, and demand another round — the Greek chorus of middle-class Dublin gossip.
sources: Glasheen, Adaline. Third Census of Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/thirdcensusoffin0000glas
Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp
Gordon, John. Finnegans Blog (Tavern chapters). https://johngordonfinnegan.weebly.com
